page.content:
Friedkin's film — still the possession standard.

How The Exorcist (1973) connects

  • Creator: William Friedkin — William Friedkin directed The Exorcist (1973).
  • Topic: The Exorcist — The 1973 film is the central work of The Exorcist.
  • Character: Regan MacNeil — The 1973 film is the story of Regan's possession.
  • Creator: William Peter Blatty — Blatty wrote the screenplay for the 1973 film.
  • Work: The Exorcist (novel) — Blatty's novel was adapted into the 1973 film.
  • Work: The Exorcist (novel) — The 1973 film is adapted from Blatty's novel.
  • Character: Father Damien Karras — Father Karras is the doubting priest of the 1973 film.
  • Character: Father Lankester Merrin — Father Merrin arrives for the 1973 exorcism.
  • Location: Georgetown — The 1973 film is shot and set in Georgetown.
  • Character: Pazuzu — The 1973 film frames the demon through Pazuzu's image.

What is The Exorcist (1973)?

The 1973 film adapts Blatty's novel with the Iraq prologue, the MacNeil house, medical tests, and the final rite on Prospect Street.

Key threads lead to William Friedkin, The Exorcist, Regan MacNeil, William Peter Blatty, The Exorcist (novel) and The Exorcist (novel).
